mockup_description.layout: Centered modal over the excuses list, triggered from the review drawer or row action.
key_elements: APPROVE modal: student summary, document preview, optional 'Note d'approbation' textarea, explicit outcome preview ('Le statut de l'absence du 19 mai 2025 sera défini sur Excusé'), audit-log warning ('Cette action sera enregistrée dans le journal d'audit avec votre identifiant et l'horodatage'), Annuler / Confirmer l'approbation

REJECT modal: student summary, document preview, MANDATORY 'Motif du refus' textarea (0/500 counter), explicit consequence notice ('Si ce justificatif est refusé, l'absence restera non justifiée pour cet élève'), audit-log warning, Annuler / Confirmer le refus (red/destructive styling)
interactions: Reject requires a stated reason -- cannot be a silent one-click action
Both actions explicitly restate the consequence before the user commits

what_matches: The underlying PATCH /api/attendance/excuses route is real and already does exactly what the approve-modal promises (flips attendance.status to excused, recalculates summary) -- this is purely a missing confirmation UI, not a missing backend capability
recordAudit() is already called on every review action, so the 'this will be logged' promise in the mockup is already true today, just not shown to the admin
what_differs: Current UI: 'Approuver'/'Refuser' buttons act IMMEDIATELY on click, no confirmation step, no optional note, and critically -- REJECT CAPTURES NO REASON AT ALL. reviewExcuseSchema only accepts {excuseId, status}, there is nowhere in the current schema or UI to record why an excuse was rejected.

missing_to_add.item: Reject reason: this is a real functional gap, not just cosmetic -- add a rejectionReason column to attendanceExcuses (small migration), require it in the PATCH schema when status='rejected', add the confirmation modal with the mandatory textarea
missing_to_add.notes: Small, well-contained fix with real product value (a parent disputing a rejected excuse currently has no recorded reason to reference).

missing_to_add.item: Approve confirmation modal with optional note + outcome preview
Surface the 'this will be audit-logged' notice (true today, just not communicated)
